title: Are we still able to recognize pearls? Machine-driven peer review and the risk to creativity: An explainable RAG-XAI detection framework with markers extraction
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical detection of AI-generated peer reviews to protect academic integrity. While it discusses the 'ethics and accountability' of using AI in the editorial process and cites research on ethical frameworks, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, moral reasoning systems, or theological beliefs within the models themselves.
